newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Big Three 1997 profit view lifted.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Big Three 1997 profit view lifted.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said analyst Steve Girsky raised estimates of 1997 profits at Chrysler Corp, Ford Motor Co and General Motors Corp on Monday.
-- The GM estimate was raised to $7 a share from $6.70. Stock is still rated neutral. Shares closed Friday at 54.
-- Ford was raised to $4.20 a share from $3.80. The stock is still rated outperform. Shares closed at 30-7/8.
-- Chrysler was raised to $4.95 a share from $4.85. It remains rated outperform. Shares closed at 30.
